name: Daytona (conch)
description: A Daytona sandbox for each workspace, with its branch cloned, made by conch-sandbox. Needs a Daytona API key: DAYTONA_API_KEY, or conch-sandbox key set daytona.
create: printf %s '' | base64 -d | sh -s -- create --provider daytona --from-orca --format orca
resume: printf %s '' | base64 -d | sh -s -- start --provider daytona --from-orca --format orca
